jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. A

You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong. Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap. The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows. The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations. Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after. The scope This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it. What we are looking for PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted. You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall. You know what policies train on. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim.. Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise. AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was. Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2. jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Account Executive - m/f/d - UK
jobs.description: Help Us Change the Way the World Works Build something that matters. Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential. About the Role You will take Langdock from first conversation to signed contract. Our customers are IT leaders, security teams, and C-Level executives at mid to large companies worldwide. This role is pivotal in driving our expansion across diverse customer segments, from innovative scale-ups and SMBs to established Global Fortune 500 clients. You'll operate as a trusted technology and AI advisor, combining full ownership of the sales cycle with the technical depth to build real credibility with today's technical buyers - the IT leads, architects, and engineers who now sit at the table alongside business executives in every AI decision. The product sells well, but enterprise deals require someone who can navigate architectural complexity, build trust with both business and technical stakeholders, and close. Strategic Revenue Development: Collaborate with partnerships, marketing, and customer success to design effective go-to-market strategies, test new markets and customer segments, and explore new revenue sources for future growth. Market Insight: Deep understanding of our Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and the ability to align solutions with their needs - and provide customer feedback to Product and Leadership to influence the roadmap. You Might Be a Fit If… You are proficient in AI technologies , with a preference for those who have previously sold AI solutions. In the best case, you have worked as a Sales Engineer or in similar positions. You have experience selling technical solutions to medium and large companies, with the ability to translate complex platform concepts into business value for non-technical executives. You're comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles by developing and executing account strategies that carry significant quota. You know how to build deep, strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives, while staying credible with the technical evaluators in the room. You're curious and customer-centric , with a talent for understanding customers' challenges and coordinating solution design tailored to their needs. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE&nbsp;</u></span></strong></p> <p>The <strong>Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle + Journeys</strong> owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for <strong>10,000+ businesses worldwide</strong>, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. jobs.description: Build Your Own Sales Business with Omada.ai Omada.ai is the AI-powered marketing platform built for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so local business owners can stop being reluctant marketers and get back to doing what they love. We’re venture-backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing fast, and looking for independent, ambitious sales partners across the UK who want to earn serious money introducing local businesses to Omada. We provide the product, the resources, and a compensation structure that means you’re never working for free. You invoice us. You manage your own tax. Location: Your local city. Must be based in the United Kingdom. Schedule: Entirely your own. Work when it suits you — mornings, evenings, weekends. Your business, your call. How the Draw Works We believe in setting our partners up for success. That’s why every Territory Partner receives a guaranteed weekly draw of £500 — as long as you’re generating results. Weeks 1–4: Generate at least 3 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week Week 5 onward: Generate at least 4 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week In any week where your commissions from closed accounts exceed £500, you earn the full commission instead The draw is ongoing — not just for your first month. Hit your numbers, get paid. Every week. This means you’re never working for nothing while your pipeline builds. Trials convert to paying customers, commissions grow, and the draw becomes your floor — not your ceiling. What You’ll Be Doing You’ll be visiting local businesses — salons, restaurants, gyms, coffee shops, pet groomers, dental practices — and showing them how Omada.ai can handle their marketing while they focus on running their business. A typical approach might look like this: Identify businesses in your area that could benefit from better marketing Walk in and start a conversation — "Hi, I work with Omada.ai . Who handles your social media?" Show a quick demo on your phone Offer a 14-day free trial — no risk for them Follow up — when they convert, you earn your commission We provide a resource kit with demo scripts, objection-handling guides, and territory mapping tools. How you use them is entirely up to you. Who Thrives as a Territory Partner Self-starters who don’t need someone managing their diary People comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation Entrepreneurial types who want to build something, not just clock hours Anyone with sales, field marketing, or B2B experience (helpful but not required) People who want uncapped income tied to their effort, not a salary cap What You’ll Need UK-based with the right to work in the United Kingdom Registered (or willing to register) as self-employed with HMRC Smartphone with internet access Reliable transport or a walkable territory with high business density The drive to build your own business No degree required. jobs.title: Founding Head of GTM - Cipherscale
jobs.description: The Opportunity: Zero-to-one category creation for AI-Native Zero Trust Access Cipherscale is building an AI-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents. The product doctrine is simple: AI may reason and propose; deterministic policy authorizes; trusted enforcement executes. We are looking for a commercial founder/operator who can turn that architecture into a category, a repeatable customer problem, real deployments, and initial revenue. Mission: discover and prove the repeatable commercial truth for Cipherscale - who urgently needs it, what gets them to deploy, what makes them pay, and what causes them to expand. What You Own • Own ICP discovery, exclusion criteria, buyer/champion mapping, problem validation, positioning, initial wedge, and design-partner recruitment. • Personally lead early customer discovery, technical/commercial conversations, executive outreach, design-partner conversion, and initial closing. • Build an evidence-driven GTM system: every important assumption has supporting/contradicting evidence and a next falsification test. • Use AI agents aggressively for research, account intelligence, personalization, competitive monitoring, meeting preparation, call synthesis, content, and experiment analysis. • Work directly with the CEO on category creation and major strategic accounts. • Work with Product and Engineering to convert recurring customer evidence into governed product inputs - without turning prospect anecdotes into roadmap commitments. • Define the first repeatable acquisition, deployment, conversion, and expansion motion before scaling a team. What This Role Is Not • It is not a traditional marketing leadership job. • It is not an MQL, impressions, content-calendar, or brand-campaign role. • It is not a decision to hire SDR, demand-gen, content, and marketing-ops teams before product-market evidence exists. • It is not ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established-business growth mandate; This role is focused on Cipherscale zero-to-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority. Important: This is a full-time remote job, and it will be a long-term B2B contract. This can be a permanent employment opportunity for candidates based in Spain, Poland, and Germany. Our philosophy is that we are a small, close-knit team, and we care deeply about you: Highly competitive salary + Bonus Fully remote work environments. Self-managed time off. Who We Want • You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI product from near-zero to repeatable initial revenue. • You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI-platform leader and earn credibility. • You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy, enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius. • You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection. • You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount. • You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality. • You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees. Strong Background Signals • Early-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise-security categories. • Founder, first-GTM, product-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit. • Large-company titles alone are not compelling. Anti-Profile • Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team." • You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery. • You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention. • You cannot personally run tech

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Personalization
jobs.description: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it. What You'll Do Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust. Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline. Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes. Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums. Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search. Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health. Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects. Who You Are You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users). You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness. You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search. You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization. You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives. You communicate with clarity and conviction, with the ability to translate technical complexity into compelling narratives for leadership, bet owners, and cross-functional partners. You have experience mentoring and developing early-career PMs, and can influence without authority or direct reporting lines. You bring familiarity with music, audio, or media technology and understand the unique dynamics of content-rich platforms. You have experience operating Search as a platform that serves multiple internal teams or content verticals. You have worked in content integrity, trust & safety, or regulatory compliance in the context of search or discovery systems. Where You'll Be This role is based in London or Stockholm. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure Architect with IRS MBI Clearance
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AWS Cloud Infrastructure Architect with IRS MBI Clearance based in United Kingdom. This role is responsible for designing and managing secure, scalable AWS cloud infrastructure across complex multi-account environments. You will shape cloud architecture spanning account governance, networking, identity and access management, security, and compliance. The position requires hands-on expertise with AWS Organizations, Control Tower, Landing Zone Architecture, and GovCloud environments. You will help establish resilient cloud foundations while supporting stringent regulatory and security requirements, including FedRAMP. Working closely with engineering and security teams, you will provide architectural guidance and help drive infrastructure best practices. The role also includes infrastructure automation, cost optimization, disaster recovery, and technical documentation. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the reliability, security, and scalability of a mission-critical cloud environment. Accountabilities: Design and implement AWS account structures using AWS Organizations, including Organizational Units aligned with business and technical requirements. Establish account governance policies, standards, consolidated billing, and cost allocation strategies. Deploy and manage AWS Control Tower for automated account provisioning, governance, and organizational controls. Design and implement Landing Zone Architecture for secure, scalable, multi-account AWS environments. Architect and deploy multi-region VPC environments, including subnets, route tables, network ACLs, and network segmentation strategies. Configure and manage Site-to-Site VPN, Client VPN, AWS Direct Connect, and Transit Gateway connectivity. Design hybrid and multi-VPC networking solutions and manage DNS through Amazon Route 53. Architect network solutions for AWS GovCloud environments. Design and implement IAM policies, roles, permission boundaries, identity federation, and organization-level Service Control Policies. Establish least-privilege access models and MFA requirements while maintaining IAM governance and compliance frameworks. Develop and implement organization-wide security policies, monitoring, and incident response procedures. Configure and manage AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, AWS Config, CloudTrail, WAF, and Shield. Implement encryption strategies for data at rest and in transit and support vulnerability management and security assessments. Maintain security and compliance controls aligned with SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, and other applicable frameworks. Design and maintain security architectures for AWS GovCloud regions. Part of the Rocket Science Group, Atomic Theory comprises a multinational team of seasoned AAA veterans with roots extending from Blizzard, PUBG, Epic, and Unity. We're dedicated to aiding studios and publishers in navigating the toughest challenges across today's game development landscape -- and with offices in Albany NY, Brighton UK and Cardiff UK, we thrive at the opportunity to Get Sh!t Done on a global scale. Our passion for gaming is at the core of everything we do, inspiring us to collaborate seamlessly. We're not afraid to take on big challenges and push for bold, innovative solutions. Every decision we make is guided by the goal of delivering maximum value and creating a significant, positive impact on our projects. By consistently going above and beyond, we transform every interaction into an exceptional partnership, building trust and delivering excellence. Customer-Facing Collaboration: Act as a senior technical representative to our partners, gathering requirements, presenting solutions, communicating trade-offs clearly, and building the trust that underpins great co-development relationships. Critical Problem Solving: Apply strong analytical and debugging skills, including profiling and diagnostic tools, to investigate and resolve complex technical issues across gameplay, UI, and engine-level systems. Mentorship: Support and mentor engineers across the team, sharing expertise in player experience engineering and helping to grow the studio's capabilities in gameplay, UI, and 3Cs. Code Review: Champion high standards of code quality, performance, and maintainability through code reviews, constructive feedback, and by setting the example in your own work. WHAT WE VALUE: Expert Software Engineering: Extensive professional experience developing and shipping games, with the depth of judgement expected at a principal level and a history of delivering high-quality, player-facing systems. jobs.title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris. Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée. Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage. Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM. À propos du projet PLEIADES Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM. Vos principales missions seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission

jobs.title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit. The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture. The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale. In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit. About this role: Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability. Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase. Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code. Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches. Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards. Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases. In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites. Must Haves: 3+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python. Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows Experience with continuous integration tools (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar). Knowledge of build systems (e.g., Make, CMake). Understanding of distributed architecture. Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP , TCP, IP) and POSIX standards. Experience in developing multi-threaded applications. Previous team leader or manager role Nice to Haves: Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust. Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms. Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity) Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ / NATS , etc.) Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S , systemd-nspawn) Experience with space systems and concepts Some of Our Awesome Benefits: Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best Health and life insurance, we care about your health Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand ) Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable   * Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications.

From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. jobs.title: Technicien Systèmes et Réseaux - Alternance
jobs.description: 📍 Localisation : Nantes (Île de Nantes) 🕒 Date de prise de poste : janvier 2027 🌍 Langues : français courant (> C1) et anglais professionnel (> B2) 🏡 2 jours de télétravail par semaine 🤓 Lengow, une plateforme e-commerce intelligente et automatisée Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes qui permettent aux marques et aux retailers de générer une croissance rentable. Grâce à une suite complète de solutions SaaS combinant gestion de flux produits, gestion des marketplaces, veille tarifaire concurrentielle et monitoring des réseaux de distribution, Lengow permet aux marques et aux retailers d’accroître la visibilité de leurs produits, d’affiner leur stratégie tarifaire, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de mieux piloter leur réseau de distribution. Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne plus de 3 600 marques et revendeurs dans plus de 70 pays . Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi évoluer dans un environnement international et multiculturel , au contact d’équipes aux profils variés, réparties notamment entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone . À propos de l’équipe IT interne L’équipe IT interne de Lengow veille au bon fonctionnement et à la sécurité de l’environnement de travail de nos 150 collaborateurs répartis entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone . Elle est composée d’un(e) IT Manager , responsable de l’ensemble du périmètre IT interne, accompagné(e) d’un(e) alternant(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux. Notre environnement couvre notamment le support utilisateurs, la gestion du parc informatique, les systèmes et réseaux, la gestion des comptes et des accès, la sécurité et l’administration de nos outils internes . L’équipe intervient dans un environnement multi-sites et multi-OS ( Windows, macOS et Linux ) et travaille à la fois sur les opérations IT du quotidien et sur des projets d’amélioration et de modernisation de notre environnement. Objectif du poste Nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe IT et travailler au quotidien aux côtés de l’IT Manager. Cette alternance te permettra de développer une expérience concrète et polyvalente de l’IT interne , aux côtés de l’IT Manager. Tu monteras progressivement en compétences sur un périmètre IT varié, avec de plus en plus d’autonomie et de responsabilités , aussi bien sur les opérations du quotidien que sur des projets d’amélioration.  Tu évolueras dans un environnement international, avec des collaborateurs présents sur plusieurs sites, à accompagner aussi bien sur place qu’à distance . ⌨️ Tes principales missions Support utilisateurs Assurer le support IT des collaborateurs sur site et à distance Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents liés aux postes, outils et accès Préparer et accompagner les arrivées et départs des collaborateurs Escalader les problématiques complexes à l’IT Manager lorsque nécessaire Parc informatique Préparer, configurer et maintenir les équipements utilisateurs Participer au suivi du parc et à la gestion de l’inventaire IT Intervenir sur des environnements Windows, macOS et Linux Participer au renouvellement et au déploiement des équipements Systèmes, accès & réseaux Participer à l’administration de Google Workspace et Active Directory Contribuer à la gestion des comptes, groupes et droits utilisateurs Participer au maintien et au dépannage du réseau : Wi-Fi, VLAN, switches et connectivité Contribuer au maintien en condition opérationnelle de l’environnement IT Sécurité & amélioration continue Contribuer au déploiement des mises à jour et outils de sécurité Participer au suivi de la sécurité des postes de travail Contribuer à la documentation des procédures et de l’environnement IT Participer à l’amélioration et à l’automatisation des processus IT Accompagner l’IT Manager sur différents projets d’évolution de l’environnement Requirements 🏹 Profil recherché Connaissances : Bases solides en réseau (TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLAN) Connaissances initiales en admin

jobs.title: Commercial Terrain - Indépendant (Freelance)
jobs.description: Commercial(e) terrain indépendant(e) – SumUp Vous avez une réelle expérience de la prospection à froid, sur le terrain ou par téléphone ? Rejoignez SumUp et accompagnez les commerçants avec des solutions de paiement simples et reconnues. Vos missions Prospecter les cafés, restaurants, boutiques, salons et entreprises de votre secteur ; Identifier leurs besoins, présenter la solution adaptée et réaliser des démonstrations ; Accompagner les commerçants jusqu'à l'activation et développer votre portefeuille. La prospection est réalisée par vos soins : aucun portefeuille de leads n'est fourni. Votre rémunération Cette activité est rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire fixe ni plafond : 50 % de commission immédiate sur le matériel, les logiciels et les paiements générés par le commerçant au cours de son premier mois ; 20 % de revenus récurrents sur l'activité de chaque commerçant signé, versés mensuellement pendant une durée pouvant aller jusqu'à 24 mois. Exemple : un commerçant actif générant environ 15 000 € de volume de paiement mensuel peut vous permettre de percevoir plus de 1 000 € de commissions cumulées sur 24 mois. Ce montant indicatif varie selon les produits vendus, l'activation, le volume réel et le maintien de l'activité du commerçant. Aucun revenu minimum n'est garanti. Vos outils et votre organisation SumUp fournit une formation initiale, un terminal de démonstration et des supports commerciaux. Un référent de secteur reste disponible pour vous accompagner. Votre zone est définie pendant le recrutement selon votre localisation et les secteurs ouverts. Vous organisez librement votre activité. Vos déplacements et les frais associés restent à votre charge ; aucun véhicule de fonction n'est fourni. Votre profil Au moins un an d'expérience en prospection à froid, terrain ou téléphonique, au cours des six dernières années ; À l'aise dans une démarche commerciale proactive auprès de professionnels ; Autonome, persévérant(e), fiable et orienté(e) résultats ; Disponible au moins trois jours par semaine ; Numéro SIRET valide au démarrage. Processus de recrutement Échange téléphonique avec notre équipe recrutement ; Entretien avec le ou la référente de votre secteur ; Décision rapide fondée sur votre expérience et votre motivation. Envie de développer votre activité avec une rémunération sans plafond et des revenus récurrents potentiels ? jobs.description: Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results. The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic. READ THIS PART FIRST Legion is not a normal web application. It is command and control software that has to present dense real-time information, coordinate distributed systems, and continue being useful when communications are imperfect. WHAT WE DO Swarm Aero is redefining air power. We are building autonomous aircraft and Legion, command and control software designed to coordinate large numbers of heterogeneous autonomous systems. Our team combines experience building novel aircraft, scaling startups, and delivering technology for national security. THE INTERNSHIP You will own a scoped project with a clear technical or business outcome, work directly with the people responsible for the system, and present what you built and learned at the end of the summer. The goal is not to give you practice work. It is to give you useful work with the support to do it well. WHAT YOU'LL DO · Build product features across frontend, backend, full-stack, real-time, or forward-deployed software · Develop interfaces for telemetry, geospatial data, mission planning, scheduling, collaboration, or system health · Build and operate backend services, APIs, event-driven systems, or data pipelines · Write automated tests, improve developer tooling, and help ship production-quality software · Support integration and test events, debug issues across services and networks, and turn what you learn into product improvements WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR · Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field, with graduation and enrollment requirements to be confirmed. · Strong programming fundamentals and experience building a substantial software project · Experience with a modern frontend framework, backend language, systems language, or full-stack application · Ability to explain technical tradeoffs, debug methodically, and write maintainable code WHAT SETS YOU APART · React, TypeScript, Go, Python, Rust, C++, or similar tools · Distributed systems, networking, real-time applications, maps, games, simulation, or data visualization · Linux, Docker, CI/CD, customer-facing engineering, or deployed project experience WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED Aerospace experience, a perfect GPA, or a previous internship at a famous company. jobs.title: Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content
jobs.description: About Genesis AI Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world. About the Role A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem. We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out. The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't. Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on. You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging. What You'll Do Build and maintain the end-to-end asset pipeline, from ingestion through to validated output Design agent-driven nodes that generate input content and make decisions inside the graph, with the structured outputs, guardrails and fallbacks that make them dependable in batch Develop automated processing stages: mesh repair, retopology, decimation and LODs, UV unwrapping and texel density normalization, collision proxy generation Derive physical properties so assets behave correctly in simulation: mass, inertia, contact parameters, articulation setup Handle appearance: material conversion to PBR, texture processing, baking, and color management so assets render correctly in Nyx Define and enforce asset standards (units, orientation, pivots, naming, provenance) and build the validators that reject noncompliant assets before they reach the library Scale the pipeline to large batch runs, with caching, versioning and selective reprocessing when a stage changes Build quality checks into the pipeline itself: physics stability harnesses, render smoke tests, automated evaluation of generated content, comparison on reprocessed assets Work with the rendering, physics and research teams on what sim-ready needs to mean for each downstream use What We're Looking For (ideally) 5+ years building content or asset pipelines in games, VFX, simulation, or 3D tooling, with ownership of a pipeline in production Deep knowledge of 3D asset formats and their quirks: USD, glTF, FBX, OBJ, plus physics description formats such as URDF or MJCF Strong Python and C++ where processing needs to be fast Hands-on mesh processing expertise: remeshing, decimation, UV generation, repair operations, convex decomposition, and a clear sense of how each one fails Solid command of PBR material authoring, texture baking and color spaces Experience driving DCC tools headlessly (Blender, Houdini, Maya) and building batch or distributed job system

jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description: What Quadrants is Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast. The role You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further. It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows. The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX. Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime. What you’ll own API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches. IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality. Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform. Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking. Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works. The project as a product. Benchmark

jobs.title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
jobs.description: What we're building Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future. Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI . One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available ( paper ). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact ( paper ) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright. This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy . Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute. The role You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes: Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers. Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it. Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials… Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem. Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness. Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals. The problems waiting for you Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff. Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: About Pelico Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor. We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside. About the Role In your capacity as a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer , you will be instrumental in architecting the orchestration layer that drives Pelico across all fronts, spanning our global SaaS infrastructure to the most restricted, air-gapped enterprise environments. Your core mission is ensuring Pelico remains effortless to install, manage, and expand, irrespective of the underlying host. Operating at the crossroads of system architecture, product engineering, and field operations, you will tackle intricate technical hurdles and help define the future of AI-driven industrial infrastructure. What You’ll Do Build deployment platforms that work everywhere . Design and improve Pelico's deployment architecture across Kubernetes, Docker, single VM, air-gapped environments and private cloud using Terraform, Helm and Ansible. Create a true one-click deployment experience . Standardize installation, upgrades and operational tooling so enterprise customers can deploy Pelico reliably with minimal manual intervention. Improve platform reliability and observability . Build monitoring, diagnostics, self-remediation capabilities and operational runbooks that allow customer IT teams to operate Pelico independently. Participate in production operations. Join the team's on-call rotation, troubleshoot production incidents, and continuously improve platform reliability through operational excellence and automation. Elevate our DevOps platform . Standardize CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure practices and deployment workflows to improve engineering productivity, security and reliability across the company. Support Pelico's enterprise and federal growth . Contribute to initiatives around GovCloud, FedRAMP readiness and deployments for highly regulated aerospace and defense customers. Drive AI-powered infrastructure engineering . Explore agentic engineering and AI-assisted workflows to automate infrastructure operations, deployment, diagnostics and security. About You 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering roles in high-growth or production environments. Strong experience building and operating cloud and on-premise infrastructure using Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Helm and Ansible . Deep understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability and modern deployment practices. Solid software engineering background, ideally with Java , and an automation-first mindset. Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation , troubleshooting production incidents, and continuously improving platform reliability. Comfortable operating in ambiguity, you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges without waiting

We are looking for a Principal Mechanical Engineer, to lead the Mechanical Engineering discipline for Nyx Earth, ensuring that mechanical systems are robust, justified, verified, and ready for flight. As a Principal you will manage a team of Mechanical Engineers, drive structural design and verification activities, and ensure technical excellence across structural analysis, testing, qualification, and verification. You will coordinate your work with the Principal CAD Engineer and with the Vehicle Mechanical Architect, under the guidance of the Mechanical Design Lead. You will play a key role in enabling the successful development of one of Europe's most ambitious space vehicles. Key Responsibilities Lead the Mechanical Engineering team, defining priorities, supporting growth, and ensuring engineering excellence and delivery. Support and collaborate to the mechanical design of the spacecraft and its major assemblies, ensuring structurally efficient, robust, manufacturable, and verifiable design solutions throughout the development lifecycle. Provide technical leadership on the design of primary and secondary structures, large assemblies, equipment supports, and critical mechanical interfaces, ensuring consistency between design intent, structural justification, and verification strategy. Own structural justification activities across the spacecraft, ensuring consistency of assumptions, margins, analyses, and engineering evidence. Coordinate structural analyses and mechanical verification activities, with focus on test strategy and execution, from test definition and prediction to result interpretation and model correlation, ensuring results are coherent, traceable, and aligned with programme objectives. Ensure verification evidence generated through testing and analysis is robust, review-ready, and suitable for qualification and certification activities towards space agencies. Drive technical reviews, risk identification, and engineering maturity assessments to ensure readiness for major programme milestones. Act as a hands-on technical leader, actively contributing to engineering decisions, test campaigns, anomaly investigations, and troubleshooting efforts. What We Would Love to See from You Qualifications: Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. More than 10 years experience in spacecraft, launch vehicle, aerospace, defence, or other high-performance engineering environments. Strong background in structure design, structural analysis, justification, qualification, and verification. Proven experience leading engineering teams and developing technical talent. Demonstrated experience supporting complex structural test campaigns, from preparation and prediction through execution and data interpretation. Experience with qualification, certification, and engineering review processes. Profound knowledge of space industry standards and methodologies. Fluent in English. German, French, or Italian are an asset. Skills and Behaviors: Ability to translate complex engineering challenges into clear decisions and actionable plans. You are requested to lead a small team. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in testing and qualifying critical space systems in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment. You will report to the AIT Mechanical Principal Engineer. Key responsibilities: Integration & Test Planning: Design and plan thermal EVT (environment test) campaign at system/capsule level. Design and plan all thermal/ECLSS activities at sub-system levels (cold plate qualification, Pressure Compartment System, Ventilation system, etc..) for system and sub-system level. Support the preparation of engineering drawings for manufacture of test bench components. Lead team and activities to have a succesful integration of the Thermal system in the Capsule. Hardware Management: Define and manage flight hardware interfaces during integration (pipes, fittings, valves, MLI, heaters, sensors, harness routing, thermal fillers, etc.). Design the 3D setup of test activities and build test setup. Procure test parts and write/execute procedures for all test activities. Test Execution: Plan, define, prepare, execute, and oversee thermal/ECLSS tests in coordination with internal and external test facilities. Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide test results and generate comprehensive test reports. Support in correlate and validate models in collaboration with engineering team. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the design office and systems engineering to ensure design meets flight qualification standards. Improve the processes and procedure with the lessons learned of the previous operations. jobs.title: Tech Lead (Agent Frontend) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Recare As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe. What to expect as our Tech Lead (Agent Frontend) (m/w/d): Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals. Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you. Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We’ll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement. Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs. Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you’ll have the day off. In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Tech Lead (Agent Frontend) (m/w/d): You will take end-to-end technical ownership of the Recare Agent – our AI-native interface that orchestrates capabilities like Voice and Extract+Docs into reliable, compliant workflows for hospital environments. This is a highly visible product area where engineering decisions directly define user experience, reliability, and trust in AI-driven healthcare workflows. You own the technical direction of the Recare Agent – from architecture decisions to roadmap execution and delivery predictability. You lead the team as the technical backbone and escalation point , ensuring clarity, speed, and quality in execution. You design and evolve the agent architecture , especially around agentic UI patterns and orchestration logic. You enable the team through hands-on mentorship, code reviews, and removing blockers fast. You drive reliability, performance, observability , and security across all agent workflows in a highly sensitive healthcare context. You build and ship frontend systems using React and TypeScript, with a strong focus on scalable, maintainable architecture. You collaborate closely with Product, Design, and QA to sharpen scope, manage trade-offs, and ensure predictable delivery. You ensure production readiness through clear runbooks, stable releases, and measurable SLAs. How we build: We use a modern frontend stack to build and ship a highly interactive, AI-powered agent experience that must be fast, reliable, and safe in production healthcare environments. React and TypeScript Apollo (GraphQL proxy layer; REST-based backend services) HeroUI with styled-components Storybook (component-driven development) Webpack 5 (with parts gradually migrating to Vite / SWC) CircleCI (Jest, Cypress, visual regression testing) SonarCloud (code quality & security analysis) Here’s how we picture you as our Tech Lead (Agent Frontend) (m/w/d): You bring 6+ years of professional software development experience and have led and owned technical directions team outcomes end to end. You have strong expertise in TypeScript and React and are confident building complex, stateful UIs with asynchronous or streaming-driven interactions. You understand how to design, ship, and evolve frontend systems in a production environment with a strong focus on quality and maintainability. You bring solid foundations in CI/CD and testing framework

jobs.title: Stellvertretender Verpackungsleiter/ Teamleiter (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Stellvertretender Verpackungsprofi mit Führungsstärke gesucht – Werde unser neuer stellvertretender Verpackungsleiter (m/w/d)! Das bringst du mit Fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Lebensmittelproduktion, Abfüllung oder Speisenverpackung Sehr gute, nachgewiesene Kenntnisse im Bereich HACCP und lebensmittelrechtliche Anforderungen Erfahrung in der Führung von Produktionsteams – du weißt, wie man Menschen mitnimmt Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise auch in stressigen Situationen Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein für Qualität, Hygiene und Arbeitssicherheit Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Sicherer Umgang mit Dokumentations- und Protokollierungspflichten Noch Fragen? jobs.title: Werkstudent EV Sales & Deal Operations (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Aampere Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Wir ermöglichen es EV-Besitzer:innen, ihr Fahrzeug innerhalb von 48 Stunden zu verkaufen, und verschaffen Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundensegmenten. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, intransparent und schwer vertrauenswürdig, deshalb bauen wir die Infrastruktur, die das ändert, damit mehr Elektroautos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Wandel zur Elektromobilität wirklich an Fahrt aufnimmt. Und es funktioniert: Wir steigern unseren Umsatz Jahr für Jahr um das Vierfache und halten bereits mehr als 1 % des deutschen Consumer-EV-Wiederverkaufsmarkts. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG. Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams. Deine Mission Du hast Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und Autos sind für dich nicht einfach nur Fortbewegungsmittel, sondern ein echtes Interesse? Dann bist du bei uns im Sales Team genau richtig. Operativer Vertrieb: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team dabei, Fahrzeuge für die Auktion vorzubereiten: von der Prüfung der Daten bis hin zur finalen Aufbereitung für die Plattform. Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest unsere Verkäufer:innen durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess. Vom ersten telefonischen Kontakt bis zur Planung der Übergabe sorgst du dafür, dass intern alles reibungslos läuft. Sales-Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, bringst Ideen ein und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse schlanker, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten. Feedback für Produkt und Team: Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt weiter und hilfst so, unser Produkt gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. Startup-Alltag: Du bringst dich dort ein, wo du gebraucht wirst, mit deinen individuellen Stärken und Interessen. Das bringst du mit Dein Background: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Dein Studiengang ist für uns zweitrangig, viel wichtiger sind deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und dein Blick für saubere Prozesse. Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, telefonierst gerne und fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl. Interesse an Autos: Kein Muss, aber definitiv ein Plus, denn du wirst viel mit Fahrzeugdaten arbeiten. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du hast Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem sich Dinge schnell bewegen, zeigst Eigeninitiative und willst aktiv mitgestalten statt nur Dienst nach Vorschrift zu leisten. Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit für uns, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr. Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift. Why Aampere? Wachstum & Ownership: Du bekommst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, triffst eigene Entscheidungen und wirst als vollwertiges Teammitglied behandelt: im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du entsprechend schnell aufsteigen. Student steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle. Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten: direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn... ...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. jobs.title: Founding Brand Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Aampere Werde Teil von Aampere , einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert . Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo . Deine Mission Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %. Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt. Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft. Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt. Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet. Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung. Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir. Das bringst du mit Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut. Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen. Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war. Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären. Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert. Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren. Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen. Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus. Why Aampere? Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest. Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket : healt
